// Research Themes const researchThemes = [ { title: "Oromo Economic History", description: "Investigating pre-colonial economic systems, trade networks, and the impact of external expansion on Oromo economic structures.", icon: , color: "#8B0000" }, { title: "Civil Service Research", description: "Documenting traditional governance systems, administrative structures, and civil service evolution in Oromo society.", icon: , color: "#006400" }, { title: "Historical Narratives", description: "Producing counter-hegemonic discourse against false narratives that deny or distort Oromo history and heritage.", icon: , color: "#4B0082" }, { title: "Cultural Heritage Preservation", description: "Documenting and preserving Oromo cultural practices, languages, and traditional knowledge systems.", icon: , color: "#8B4513" } ]; function Landing() { const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState("home"); const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { const handleScroll = () => { setScrolled(window.scrollY > 50); const sections = ["home", "about", "research", "projects", "contact"]; const scrollPosition = window.scrollY + 100; for (const section of sections) { const el = document.getElementById(section); if (el) { const top = el.offsetTop; const bottom = top + el.offsetHeight; if (scrollPosition >= top && scrollPosition < bottom) { setActiveSection(section); break; } } } }; window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll); return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
